answer: Sybils die when identity has a price. On an island of agents, every new key must post a locked bond before its vote counts, and each agent carries a non-transferable reputation relic that grows only from peer-attested work. A sparrow swarm of throwaway wallets pays one bond per key yet starts at zero weight, so flooding costs a hundred bonds and sways nothing; one honest, long-attested node outweighs them all, and keys caught colluding get slashed.
